title: XamlGen Scaffold Output
description: Output of the scaffold step. Describes what a specific activity requires. The caller fills in each argument's 'value' field and uses the result as an ActivityNode in the generate input.

activityId.description: Activity identifier as provided in the scaffold input. Echoed for traceability.

fullName.description: CLR fully-qualified type name (from catalog activity.fullName).

description.description: Activity description from the catalog. null if not provided.

arguments.description: Ordered list of argument descriptors. The caller fills in 'value' for each argument they wish to supply and passes the result to the generate step.

name.description: CLR property name. Use this as the key in the generate input arguments object.

direction.description: Argument direction. In: expression string. Out: variable name to bind. InOut: expression string.

dataType.description: CLR type name of the argument (from catalog member.dataType).

required.description: Whether this argument must be supplied. Derived from catalog member metadata.

typeConverter.description: Drives XAML serialisation form. Present: attribute form. null: child element form wrapping an expression activity.

enumValues.description: Valid values when dataType is an enum, expressed as 'EnumTypeName.MemberName'. null for non-enum types.

value.description: Placeholder — always null in scaffold output. The caller replaces null with an expression string (In/InOut) or variable name (Out) before passing to the generate step.
